decisions: FINDING, doc vs tool: 04 §5.1 showed components.json aliases as filesystem paths. The shadcn CLI places files correctly from them but writes cross-atom imports with the same string, so sheet.tsx and dialog.tsx would import Button from "src/shared/components/ui/button", which TypeScript cannot resolve. components.json now uses import aliases (@shared/...) and the 04 §5.1 sample is corrected. This also fixes a latent flaw in task 004's g2.

The store seam is empty by owner decision: whitelist [], no slices; session, workspace, viewport and sync arrive with 008, 009 and 007 through the documented 4-point edit. A guard reducer stops Redux warning about an empty root reducer.
Highlight palette (owner: yellow, green, blue, rose) is defaulted, since the spec lists none; oklch, one hue each, dark keeps the hue and lowers only the alpha (spec §5.3).
ShadcnProvider is Radix's Direction.DirectionProvider (dir=ltr) because components.json has rtl: true; defaulted.
The scaffold's theme-provider moved from shared/components/template/ to shared/providers/theme-provider/ (plan doc §4); the empty template/ folder is gone.
PersistGate renders nothing until the persistor has rehydrated, and the server persists to a no-op storage, so nothing touches window at import; ponytail notes in the code.
